external_idempotency_model.M4_5_reference: PortablePlanMutationRequest.complete_identity_fingerprint() / JournalRecord.complete_external_identity() — operation + typed_target + principal + contract_hash + idempotency_key + intent_fingerprint + subject_expected_revision + authority_source_revision + authority_observed_raw_digest + candidate_raw_digest + normalized_plan_digest + authorization_reference + lease_reference
external_idempotency_model.complete_identity_required: Same idempotency_key with changed authorization (different authorization_reference/lease_reference/principal/contract_hash/typed_target/subject revision/raw precondition/candidate digest) is a different complete identity -> must not replay prior GitHub effect; must surface CONFLICT / BLOCKED, not silently reuse prior write
external_idempotency_model.same_key_same_complete_identity_replay: REPLAYED_VERIFIED or VERIFIED_RECOVERED (deterministic replay with no duplicate semantic effect if observation already equals candidate)
external_idempotency_model.same_key_changed_authorization_replay: CONFLICT fail closed (M4-3/M4-5 same-key-different-request = conflict); GitHub replay denied

github_replay_identity_details.GITHUB_REPLAY_IDENTITY_IS_STRONG: complete authorization-bound identity, not GitHub-native idempotency key
github_replay_identity_details.github_idempotency_mechanics: GitHub itself does not provide cross-attempt idempotency for Issue body updates; adapter therefore relies on Core's journal idempotencyKey + complete identity + correlation_id + attempt_reference per M4-5/M4-3; duplicate GitHub calls with same key but drifted authorization are conflicts and must not blindly rewrite
github_replay_identity_details.correlation_id: bounded safe identifier (OperationContext correlation_id) linking journal attempt to GitHub transport for dedupe observation
github_replay_identity_details.attempt_reference: bounded lease_or_attempt_reference tying this external attempt to the specific APPLYING journal attempt (at-most-one contract)
github_replay_identity_details.retry_rule: Retryable only after M4-7 reconciliation to RETRYABLE_NO_EFFECT with fresh authorization + fresh Subject precondition + fresh raw authority precondition + new bounded lease/attempt; UNKNOWN_OUTCOME blind retry denied; UNKNOWN_OUTCOME blind lease reuse denied
